What’s perhaps most noticeable about a lot of the more recent funding is how aggressive players like Nvidia, Google, Salesforce and Microsoft have been. It’s Enterprise A.I. that is booming. The partnerships between startups, vendors, cloud and so forth is really where the magic is happening and it’s emerging very early on. 

A.I. Gold Rush in Funding is Here 

I think to get a perspective on the A.I. Gold rush of funding we need to dig a bit deeper into the Inflection A.I. story.

Generative A.I. is spawning a great deal of investment in what appears to be another technology boom. The dynamics of who are funding these major moves is highly significant in how the space will later consolidate. 

Startups are also being acquired for rather large valuations as we saw recently with Casetext and MosaicML. As stocks related to Generative A.I. have been surging it’s leading to a very hot summer for Generative A.I. funding and investments.
